| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11, installer | `Naruto-Online-Launcher-Setup-*.exe` |
| Windows 10/11, portable | `Naruto-Online-Launcher-Portable-*.exe` |
| Linux, any distribution | `Naruto-Online-Launcher-*-x86_64.AppImage` (`chmod +x` first) |
| Debian, Ubuntu, Mint | `Naruto-Online-Launcher-*-amd64.deb` |

The Flash plugin is included. The builds are not code signed, so Windows SmartScreen asks once: *More info → Run anyway*.

To update, run the new installer over the installed version (or replace the AppImage). Accounts, saved logins and settings are kept.
